Maya: Quick update — the investigation for yesterday's model-serving degradation is published: https://redwood.internal/postmortems/1769999999-service-recovery
Maya: Short summary: autoscaler debounce race + stale KV-cache invalidation caused a cascade of evictions under burst traffic. Most customer requests were retried successfully but latency spiked for ~18m.
Maya: Link to full write-up + timeline + convo logs: https://redwood.internal/postmortems/1769999999-service-recovery (RCA + artifacts)
Maya: Highlighted action items (owners + target dates):
- Jordan — tighten autoscaler debounce and add deterministic test harness — target 2026-04-05
- Ellie — add end-to-end cache-warming test and CI gate (cover warm-start path) — target 2026-04-01
- Sam — alert tuning + dashboard for pre-eviction signals (SLO runnerbook update) — target 2026-03-31
Maya: I've added a short follow-up checklist in the doc (test steps, rollback plan, canary gates). Please comment on the doc if you disagree with ownership.
Jordan: On it. I'll open the PR this week and include a benchmark for debounce windows. Can someone share the load profile we used during the incident?
Ellie: I can reproduce the pattern locally with the synthetic harness, will draft the CI changes. I'll link the PR to the doc.
Sam: I can take alerting. Propose adding a warning tier 5m before eviction threshold and a runbook entry for the oncall to reduce burst. Will add to ops-runbook.
Devlin: Can we also capture customer-facing impact for support? I'll compile the list and add to the incident tracker.
IncidentBot: Incident record created: INC-4567 — https://redwood.internal/incidents/INC-4567
Jordan: @Maya added a quick patch to the autoscaler debounce in a branch, testing now. I'll tag @eng-sre for review.
Maya: Thanks — please flag any rollback concerns. If changes are heavy we can gate behind a canary in us-west-2.
Ellie: Filed PR #982 with CI draft, included the warm-start integration test results in the description.
Sam: Dashboard note — proposing a new chart for "KV eviction rate" + a derived metric for "prefetch hit ratio". Will post screenshots in doc.
Devlin: Support impact summary posted to the doc (section 4). Noted 3 customers with >99th pct latency spikes.
Maya: Scheduling: tentative 30-min checkout meeting next Tue 10:00am PT to review PRs and confirm rollouts — calendar invite: https://calendar.internal/meet/serving-checkpoint
Jordan: I can make that. +1
Ellie: +1
Sam: +1 — will bring runbook draft.
Devlin: I'll join and share customer notes.
Maya: Great. Thanks everyone for quick responses. If you can't make the meeting, please leave a short note in the doc with your blockers. :thumbsup:
